title: Keep product knowledge areas isolated
statement: As an architect maintaining product knowledge, I can change requirements, prototypes, or quality evidence independently and then inspect one validated view so a change in one area does not silently rewrite or hide another.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Changing a requirement, prototype, or quality record leaves the current histories in the other product-knowledge areas unchanged.
If any product-knowledge domain document is invalid, opening the composed view fails instead of returning partial or silently corrected data.
